'''March 2001 Hatfield tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hatfield, England on 18 March 2001. [[Peter Di Biasio]] won it. It is known from Jamie Giberti's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1942">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-hatfield-england-3-18-2k1d1942/ hatfield-england-3-18-2k1], DeckTech (Jamie "JEEBS" Giberti, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-hatfield-england-3-18-2k1d1942/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Hatfield, England
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Peter Di Biasio]]
